purpose: Return to a topic with a strong reaction despite accepting the context.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
It is hot because it is summer. Even so, today is especially hot.
I know preparation takes time. Still, this is taking too long.
Still, I am amazed you managed to carry it all this way alone.
restrictions: Often emphasizes surprise, excess, or concern after a concession.
mistake: It is not simply an additive equivalent of それに.

segments.role: Return to a topic with a strong reaction despite accepting the context. それにしても + comment
